subject: SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT function
notes: §15.5.5: a standard numeric time form value is 'a numeric value representing seconds past midnight', and with LEAP-SECOND OFF in effect (the only supported mode; §7.3.17.4 GR1 implies OFF when unspecified) it 'shall be greater than or equal to zero and less than 86,400'. The runtime returns DateTime.TimeOfDay.Ticks — always in [0, 864,000,000,000) — and the renderer types it as NumX at scale 7, so the delivered numeric value is seconds in [0, 86400) with 7 fraction digits; function type Numeric per the catalog (§15.80.1 'The type of this function is numeric'). Both range endpoints are pinned (0 at midnight; 863,999,999,999 at 23:59:59.9999999), and the golden probes the range end-to-end through COMPUTE into PIC 9(5)V9(7).
